## Handover Hubs in Solapur
1. Solapur Railway Station: Complimentary 24/7 gate handover timed with train arrivals (Vande Bharat, Siddheshwar Express, Hutatma Express).
2. Hotgi Road & Airport Hub: Fast handover for MIDC and South Solapur travelers.
3. Vijapur Road Hub: Direct connectivity to NH-52 towards Karnataka/Bijapur.
4. Akkalkot Road Hub: Strategic start point for outstation temple routes.
5. Doorstep Delivery: Available across Solapur municipal city limits.

## Pilgrimage Corridors & Distance Matrix from Solapur
- Solapur to Akkalkot (Shri Swami Samarth Maharaj Temple): 40 km (approx. 50 mins via Akkalkot Road)
- Solapur to Tuljapur (Bhavani Mata Temple): 45 km (approx. 55 mins via NH-52 Solapur-Aurangabad Hwy)
- Solapur to Pandharpur (Shri Vitthal-Rukmini Temple): 72 km (approx. 1 hr 20 mins via NH-65 / Pandharpur Hwy)
- Solapur to Gangapur (Dattatreya Temple, Karnataka): 90 km (approx. 1 hr 45 mins)

## Rental Eligibility & Required Documents
- Age Requirement: 21+ years for cars, 18+ years for bikes.
- Driving License: Original Indian Driving License (LMV for cars, MCWG for motorcycles).
- Identity Proof: Aadhaar Card or Passport (verified digitally during online checkout).
- Advance Token: ₹500 advance payment online via Razorpay (UPI, Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking) to lock the vehicle schedule; remaining balance payable at vehicle key handover.
- Fuel Policy: Level-to-level handover (return with same fuel level as received).
- Security Deposit: Transparent, nominal verification without hidden retention.
